notes: Four-lane parallel sweep (ai / bigtech+hardware+mobile / devtools+cloud / security), each briefed with the manifest, the three most recent run logs, and the relevant slice of already-filed 2026-09/10/11 entries so budget went to fresh ground and known corrections. All lanes hit the expected EGRESS_BLOCKED on direct fetches to org domains; every filed entry rests on a search result quoting or citing the organisation's own page, or is explicitly noted where it rests on secondary reporting/trackers. Today's Apple fall iPhone event dominated the bigtech/hardware/mobile lane (iPhone 18 Pro/Pro Max, Apple's first foldable iPhone Duo, the in-house C2 modem, new CEO John Ternus's first keynote) and the already-filed 'Apple fall iPhone event' entry was refiled with the actual outcome plus separate on-sale-date entries for each device line. The AI lane firmed up the Amazon Bedrock AI21 Jamba 1.5 / TwelveLabs Marengo Embed 2.7 retirement date (now sourced to AWS's own Jamba 1.5 Mini model-card page for that model, though Marengo's date is still only a secondary-tracker match) and found two new OpenAI API retirement dates (Nov 30 and Dec 11, 2026) plus confirmed ICLR 2027 dates. The devtools/cloud lane's standout finding: AWS quietly delayed the Lambda deprecated-runtime update-lockout deadline from September 30, 2026 to March 3, 2027 (new-function-creation blocked from February 1, 2027) — see concerns below, since this correction cannot cleanly merge into the existing September entry through the normal id/date-drift matching. The security lane found a new, unusually short 3-day CISA KEV deadline (Sept 11) for two of the four CVEs added Sept 8, and a combined CA/Browser Forum + Chrome Root Program certificate-policy change landing 2027-03-15. The ST Engineering/MetaEncryptor ransomware claim (filed rumored on 2026-09-07) remains neither confirmed nor denied as of today.
concerns: AWS delayed the Lambda deprecated-runtime update-lockout from September 30, 2026 to March 3, 2027 (new-function-creation blocked from February 1, 2027) — a genuine correction to the already-filed 'AWS Lambda locks out further updates to Python 3.9 functions' (2026-09-30, id ending -2026-09) entry. Because the new date is ~154 days later, it falls outside src/lib/id.ts's EVENT_DRIFT_DAYS=75 window (and the event's id bucket moves from 2026-09 to 2027-03), so the merge logic in mergeAll()/isSameThing() will not recognize this as the same entry even with an identical title — it will file as a new, separate entry rather than replacing the stale one. A maintainer should manually mark the old September entry as superseded/remove it, since the routine cannot hand-edit data/ directly; this is a real gap in the drift-window logic for large date corrections, not a one-off.

The Amazon Bedrock 'AI21 Jamba 1.5 and TwelveLabs Marengo Embed 2.7' entry is refiled at 'expected' rather than 'confirmed': AWS's own Jamba 1.5 Mini model-card page gives November 26, 2026 for that specific model, but TwelveLabs Marengo Embed 2.7's date is still only corroborated by secondary trackers (vorplabs.com) after three consecutive runs — worth a maintainer checking the AWS console/Bedrock API directly for Marengo's own lifecycle date.

The OpenAI Navier-Stokes Millennium Prize Problem claim is filed as announced but is itself disputed (the Clay Mathematics Institute has not accepted it, and a mathematician has publicly alleged the system drew on his unpublished work) — summary is written neutrally to reflect that dispute rather than reporting the claim as settled fact.
